title: Q-GAP-other-cloud-proof: Prove one non-Cloudflare cloud end to end
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** every executor run
**Done check:** file:docs/bootstrapping/other-cloud-proof.json
**Status:** closed

Gap in component `portability`: Prove one non-Cloudflare cloud end to end. Briefs exist; nothing is proven off Cloudflare. Source: doctrine/market.json (MARKET-1).

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 221.4 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
